summary: Preserve Function.prototype.toString via runtime/source metadata because ECMAScript functions expose original source text when available.

target.notes: Runtime function objects must retain source text or a spec-permitted native-function representation. Reconstructing from generated C# is not semantically valid.

semantics.ecmascript_function: returns original source text when host source is available

caveats: Whitespace and comments can be observable in returned source.
Bound functions generally stringify as native-function style rather than target source.

tests.name: comments and spacing observable
tests.expected_behavior: prints true when source text is available
